extraction.Name: Emma Coryell
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent recorded Sep. 14, 1918, by Home Abstract Co, Martin, So. Dak.
extraction.Buyer: Deeded to Frank B. Smith, Jordan, Nebr. by Emma Coryell and Earl Coryell, husband and wife, on September 7, 1918 for $1100.00
extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jul. 1, 1918. Agreement for Warranty Deed to Frank B. Smith, signed by Earl F. Coryell and Emma Coryell, on Aug. 9, 1918, for $1100.00 cash, agreeing to furnish a good clear title, free of all encumbrance, for NE 1-37-24, recorded Aug. 26, 1918. Lots 1 & 2 & S½ of NE 1-37-34 deeded to Frank B. Smith. Earl Coryell appears to be husband of Emma Coryell.
